# Debug the month calculation
import arrow
from dateutil import tz as dateutil_tz

arw_jan = arrow.Arrow(2023, 1, 1)
arw_mar = arrow.Arrow(2023, 3, 1)

# Manually trace through the logic
self_dt = arw_jan._datetime
dt = arw_mar._datetime
delta_second = int(round((self_dt - dt).total_seconds()))
sign = -1 if delta_second < 0 else 1
diff = abs(delta_second)

print(f"delta_second = {delta_second}")
print(f"sign = {sign}")
print(f"diff = {diff}")
print(f"_SECS_PER_MONTH = {arrow.Arrow._SECS_PER_MONTH}")
print(f"_SECS_PER_MONTH * 2 = {arrow.Arrow._SECS_PER_MONTH * 2}")
print(f"_SECS_PER_YEAR = {arrow.Arrow._SECS_PER_YEAR}")
print(f"diff < _SECS_PER_MONTH: {diff < arrow.Arrow._SECS_PER_MONTH}")
print(f"diff < _SECS_PER_MONTH * 2: {diff < arrow.Arrow._SECS_PER_MONTH * 2}")
print(f"diff < _SECS_PER_YEAR: {diff < arrow.Arrow._SECS_PER_YEAR}")

# Approximate month count
approx_months = abs((dt.year * 12 + dt.month) - (self_dt.year * 12 + self_dt.month))
print(f"approx_months = {approx_months}")

# Shift check
months_count = approx_months
if sign == -1:
    while months_count > 0:
        shifted = arw_jan.shift(months=months_count)
        print(f"  Checking shift(months={months_count}): {shifted} <= {arw_mar}? {shifted._datetime <= dt}")
        if shifted._datetime <= dt:
            break
        months_count -= 1
else:
    while months_count > 0:
        shifted = arw_jan.shift(months=-months_count)
        print(f"  Checking shift(months=-{months_count}): {shifted} >= {arw_mar}? {shifted._datetime >= dt}")
        if shifted._datetime >= dt:
            break
        months_count -= 1

print(f"Final months_count = {months_count}")
